description.value: Wings Tsawwassen is a casual chain restaurant known for award-winning chicken wings available in 28 globally-inspired flavours, located in the Tsawwassen Mills shopping complex. The location is designated food-primary and all-ages, with a broad menu spanning wings, burgers, salads, and pasta alongside a weekend brunch offering. Its position near the BC Ferries Tsawwassen terminal makes it a convenient meal stop for cyclists arriving or departing by ferry.
